findings.what: Three new comments since r36 (Chrome, recent-comments sort, ~09:17Z), none disclosing a knob value, dataset or technique we can build. (a) 744273 (SGHWR, now '49TH'), Satwik (#411, ~09:08Z): 'I believe the public LB has very few divisions.' Satwik reports that division changes with consistent local gains (held-out 41 videos, all 199, an external dataset) gave 'either no change or a slight drop' on the LB. The guess is that the public embryo is easier and less dense, and that the public model (x138 family) 'might fall apart on private LB'. This is an unverified opinion. It fits our own record: division knobs K and DIS moved the public LB by only +0.001-0.002, and division lab gains transfer poorly. It adds no new fact for the finals choice, which stays with the user (V_pub + #37 or exp75).
